description:
About the company
 Our client is a technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Serve as the hands-on technical lead for a client rollout, pairing customer-facing communication with production coding across the implementation. The role suits an engineer who can explain technical ideas to non-specialists while shipping reliable code in a regulated setting.
 What you'll do
 - Lead implementation for client accounts, loading their course materials, documents and recordings into the platform's knowledge and data models.
 - Manage prompts and service orchestration within a restricted cloud environment under strict security controls.
 - Build client-requested features across front-end and back-end code, including interface changes, new data tables and file handling.
 - Lead customer calls and explain AI concepts in plain language for non-technical audiences.
 - Divide time between hands-on coding, customer work and internal coordination, with roughly half the week spent coding.
 - Travel to client sites during the early phases of a project.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - One to three years of experience in an engineering role.
 - Hands-on experience with a major cloud AI platform such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
 - A bachelor's degree in computer science or a STEM-related field.
 - Experience shipping LLM or agent systems to production.
 - Solid hands-on coding ability in a server-side scripting language, a typed web language and a React-based web framework.
 - Background delivering software in public-sector or compliance-bound environments that carry formal authorization requirements.
 - Willingness to work on-site five days a week.
 Bonus points
 - Experience working in a fast-paced environment building new products from scratch.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: $130K - $170K
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - Los Altos, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days in-office per week
 - Full-time
